titulo: Walgreens, Lennar and Waters: the exit payment in the 8-K, in years of median employee pay
caption:
Walgreens, Lennar and Waters: the exit payment in the 8-K, in years of median employee pay

From the archive: 2020 to 2023.

Lennar, Jul 14, 2023
The math: $20.2 million (separation payment to the retiring Co-CEO, 2023) ÷ $109,229 (median associate's pay, fiscal 2023) = about 185 years of median pay

Walgreens Boots Alliance, Sep 1, 2023
The math: $9 million (cash severance in the CEO's separation agreement, 2023) ÷ $34,763 (median employee's pay, fiscal 2023) = about 258 years of median pay

Waters Corporation, Jun 17, 2020
The math: $4.25 million (cash severance in the CEO's separation agreement, 2020) ÷ $67,703 (median employee's pay, 2020) = about 62 years of median pay

Retire. Step down. Departure. Here is the exit column. (Our take.)

Sources: Lennar, Form 8-K, filed Jul 14, 2023; Lennar, Form DEF 14A, filed Feb 29, 2024; Walgreens Boots Alliance, Form 8-K, filed Sep 1, 2023; Walgreens Boots Alliance, Form DEF 14A, filed Dec 8, 2023; Waters Corporation, Form 8-K, filed Jun 17, 2020; Waters Corporation, Form DEF 14A, filed Apr 1, 2021.

Slide 4 of 7. Cobalt blue poster with white type. Waters Corporation, Jun 17, 2020. Slide 5 of 7. Cobalt blue poster with white type. Title: How we count. For each company, the number A and the number B from its filing (shortened, never rounded up), with the form and the date, and the rule: each result is divided and never rounded up; anything approximate says about.

Slide 6 of 7. Cobalt blue poster with white type. Title: What this does not say. Only the amount the 8-K gives is counted. Walgreens: the cash severance only, not the other items the 8-K lists. These are agreed amounts, not what has been paid. Waters' is payable over two years. Lennar's agreement is in exchange for a release of claims. Its leader retired as a co-CEO. Our take: Retire. Step down. Departure. Here is the exit column.
